claim_summary: Let \(X\) be a nondegenerate regular curve and \(f:X\to X\) a homeomorphism with finite chain recurrent set. Then \(h_{\mathrm{pol}}(f)=1\). For every integer \(n\ge 2\) and every \(1\le m<n\), \[h_{\mathrm{pol}}(F_n(f))=h_{\mathrm{pol}}(\mathcal{S}F_n(f))=h_{\mathrm{pol}}(\mathcal{S}F_n^{m}(f))=n.\] Moreover the induced map on the full hyperspace satisfies \(h_{\mathrm{pol}}(2^f)=+\infty\). Thus every finite-particle symmetric-product layer and every generalized symmetric-product-suspension quotient has the exact linear entropy level \(n\), whereas the full closed-set hyperspace has infinite polynomial entropy.
integrity: The claim is obtained by matching the exact hypotheses and conclusions of two independently read primary papers and one standard regular-curve recurrence identity stated in the motivating paper. No numerical experiment, inaccessible lemma, or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes a nondegenerate regular curve, a homeomorphism, and a finite chain recurrent set. It does not cover arbitrary continuous maps, infinite chain recurrent sets, or continua outside the regular-curve class, and it does not determine sub-polynomial growth constants.
title: Exact finite-to-infinite polynomial entropy spectrum for finite-chain-recurrent regular curves
